row.evidence: Pleo's pricing table marks HRIS integrations 'Not included' on Build and 'Included' on Optimise, and its help centre says user provisioning through SCIM 'availability depends on your plan'.
row.notes: SCIM plan is read from the pricing page's 'HRIS integrations' row (Optimise only): Pleo's help centre treats Okta and Entra SCIM as part of 'User management through your HR system' and says availability depends on plan; Pleo's Okta page also points to the HRIS integration guide. The developer Okta guide and the Entra integration page still name the retired 'Advanced plan' (see conflicts). US prices used; the UK page also offers a monthly-only Start plan at £8/user (max 1 admin), not sold in the US. SAML SSO is on every plan per the pricing table. Okta SCIM supports create, userName-only update and deactivate (reactivation possible; deactivated users deleted after two weeks); Entra uses a non-gallery SCIM app with a tenant URL and secret token. Google Workspace and HR systems sync by Pleo-run pull every 3 hours.

plans.name: Start (UK only)
plans.price_text: £8 per user / month, monthly billing only, max 1 admin
plans.notes: Shown on the UK (GBP) pricing page only; HRIS integrations 'Not included' and SAML SSO 'Included' on the UK table too. Price is GBP so per-user USD left null.

plans.name: Build
plans.price_text: $14 per user / month, billed yearly, 3 users minimum

plans.name: Optimise
plans.price_text: $18 per user / month, billed yearly, 3 users minimum
plans.notes: SCIM inferred from the 'HRIS integrations' row plus the help-centre statement that SCIM availability depends on plan.

scim.notes: Version 2.0 and base URL taken from the Pleo external OpenAPI spec tag ('API available at /scim/v2', server https://external.pleo.io) which cites RFC 7644; the per-tenant Tenant URL is shown in Pleo settings.

auth.token_source: Pleo Settings > Integrations > People management > Microsoft Entra > Allow access (copy Tenant URL and Secret token)

operations.notes: Only userName updates are supported; Okta OIN page shows Group Push unticked.

deprovision.data_retained: Account is deactivated (cards frozen per Pleo's Okta page); deactivated users are deleted within two weeks unless reactivated.

attributes.notes: userName (email) is the only attribute Pleo documents; updates to other fields are not supported.

limitations.text: Only userName updates are supported; updates to other fields are not.
Okta Import feature is not supported.
Provisioned users must still be invited in Pleo before they can spend; they become billable once they accept and sign in.
Entra provisioning uses a non-gallery enterprise app, not a gallery SCIM app.

user_api.notes: The current External API only reads employees and manages teams. Employee create/update/delete exist only in the deprecated legacy API (openapi.pleo.io/v1), which new API keys cannot use. No plan gate for Standalone API Keys is stated; the guide requires Admin or Bookkeeper permissions.

Remove an employee from a team

webhooks_user_events.notes: The webhook events page lists export-job and vendor events only.

limitations.text: Legacy APIs that could create, update and delete employees are deprecated; new customers only get the new API keys.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate (read from page markup); Group Push not ticked.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO only; provisioning uses a non-gallery enterprise app pointed at Pleo's SCIM tenant URL.

google.notes: Google Workspace is listed among the HR systems Pleo pulls users from (every 3 hours).

fallbacks.other_sync: Pleo-run HRIS sync (Personio, HiBob, BambooHR, Google Workspace, Workday and others), pulled every 3 hours, with optional team sync from the manager hierarchy
